AnalyticsService reads the till through `.rpc("pos_item_sales"`, and its `const cogs =` statement multiplies `bottlesOut` by the recorded cost, names no `orders` (e2cbe426a summed DELIVERED procurement_orders, analytics.service.ts:428) and is null when `soldRows.length === 0` (a till that moved no stock has no cost to read; the first build printed 0 and a 100% margin). `const skuRevenue =` weighs `weighed` and no `unitPrice` (e2cbe426a weighed menu price x bottles on hand, :725-726), and `const weighed =` keeps an unsold item only when `s.mapped` and `activeIds.has` it, so an active row no POS mapping points at is not a 0 weight (the first build weighed every active row; Tuzlu's 18 unmapped menu rows, A-013, would lift the truth 0.565 to about 0.62).
